sources.title: GDPR — baseline (legal basis & rights)
sources.why: GDPR requires mapping each purpose to a legal basis, enforcing the data-minimization principle of collecting only what is necessary.

sources.title: ePrivacy Art. 5(3) — access to terminal equipment (cookies, SDKs, trackers)
sources.why: It bars reading or storing data on a device unless strictly necessary, directly limiting non-essential data collection.
